parameters.name: ConnectionProperties
parameters.description:
The connection properties of the data source, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The envType property is a member of this object and specifies the data source environment. Valid values:
- Dev: development environment.
- Prod: production environment.

Different data source types have different property specifications under different connection patterns (ConnectionPropertiesMode). For more information, see [Data source connection properties ConnectionProperties](~~2852465~~).

parameters.name: ConnectionPropertiesMode
parameters.description:
The connection mode of the data source. Different types have different subtypes with different parameter constraints. For example, a MySQL data source supports the following modes:
- InstanceMode (instance mode)
- UrlMode (connection string mode)

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the data source. The description can be up to 3,000 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data source. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit or underscore. The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/overview) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the data source. More than 70 data source types are supported. For more information about the enumerated data source types, refer to References: [Data source type list](~~2852465~~).
